name: Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Work with other teens and librarian mentors on projects at a Pima County library branch. Teens log their own hours.
duration: Not stated. Teens track hours with a log.
how_to_apply: Fill out the volunteer application form (PDF on the page) and give it to the library branch where you want to volunteer. The library contacts you if there is an opening.
notes: The application PDF on the page is labeled 2024. Openings depend on each branch, so ask staff.
